extra.reason: Owner approved the proposed deterministic static truss approach, idealized joints, shared stick budget, progressive failure, and educational framing.
Implemented the dependency-free responsive workshop shell, semantic controls, accessible Canvas regions, reduced-motion CSS, and local static serving.

Implemented one-stick triangular-lattice topology, mandatory deck/support/load nodes, deterministic binary genomes, valid baseline trusses, diverse deterministic seeds, budget handling, and connectivity validation.

Implemented the pure 2D truss stiffness solve, support reactions, event-driven tension/buckling thresholds, member removal and redistribution, and deterministic collapse results; manually verified a known triangle and failure cases.
Added a dependency-free Node test suite for lattice/genome invariants, support reactions, tension failure, buckling, instability, cascaded breakage, and deterministic evaluation; npm test passes.
Implemented seed-based initial populations, tournament selection, uniform crossover, bit mutation, elitism, budget/connectivity normalization, and stable fitness ordering; GA tests pass.
Added Canvas truss rendering, stress/buckling color cues, broken-member gaps, load interpolation from immutable failure events, replay, and reduced-motion pacing.
Added selectable bridge thumbnails, per-candidate test status/load, top-five leaderboard, current champion highlighting, best/average generation history, and accessible chart descriptions.
Wired pause/resume, one-bridge stepping, fast-forward, replay, seeded reset, speed/mutation sliders, keyboard-native controls, and generation advancement; pause preserves in-flight load progress.
Added versioned localStorage snapshots with topology/model validation, genome revalidation, progress/settings/history restore, clear/delete action, and recoverable errors; persistence tests pass.
README now documents running, controls, reproducible GA, model/scoring assumptions, limitations, attribution, and manual smoke steps.
